up: Retrieve all exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613886. Include the compound ChEMBL ID, compound preferred name, activity standard type, standard value, and standard units for each record.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_pref_name,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613886'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
